name: DOLLS: Echoes Between the Frames
source:
When Izumi and her sister Tiara meet a struggling photographer named Daisuke, they see more than an opportunity to help—they discover a chance to step into a world they've always dreamed of. Determined to help her sister gain confidence, Izumi encourages Tiara to embrace the spotlight and explore her potential.

What begins as a simple photography project gradually becomes a journey of self-discovery, meaningful connections, and heartfelt emotions. Along the way, they meet Rie, a quiet and stylish girl with a passion for fashion who finds it difficult to express her true feelings, and Kari, a reserved young woman whose past has left emotional scars she is still trying to overcome.

As each photo session brings them closer together, friendships deepen, feelings begin to blossom, and personal dreams are put to the test. Every choice you make influences their relationships, shaping not only their futures, but also the bonds they share.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1406521641/dolls-echoes-between-the-frames-1/]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
当泉与妹妹蒂亚拉邂逅郁郁寡欢的摄影师大辅时，她们看到的不仅是一次伸出援手的契机，更是一扇迈入梦寐以求之世界的大门。一心想要帮妹妹树立自信的泉，鼓励蒂亚拉勇敢站到聚光灯下，发掘自身的无限潜能。

起初只是一场单纯的摄影企划，却渐渐演变为一段探索自我、缔结真挚羁绊与倾注满腔真情的旅程。途中，她们结识了热爱时尚却不擅表露真心的文静潮女理惠，以及被过往情感创伤所困、至今仍在努力走出阴影的内敛少女香织。

随着一次次拍摄将众人的心越拉越近，友情日益深厚，懵懂的情愫悄然绽放，每个人的梦想也迎来了现实的考验。你做出的每一个选择都将左右她们之间的关系，不仅决定她们各自的未来，也将塑造彼此相系的羁绊。

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1406521641/dolls-echoes-between-the-frames-1/]Kickstarter[/url]]
